content: Dating apps collect highly sensitive special-category data (photos, sexual orientation, ethnicity, health) that carries elevated legal/privacy risk (GDPR special category data). Best practice: encrypt at rest and in transit, minimize retention, strip EXIF/location metadata from uploaded photos, provide account/data deletion, and keep privacy policy explicit about what sensitive fields are collected and why. Photo moderation commonly gated before photos are visible to other users (manual review pre-match).
